_comment: Authored datablock values (task 1.15), merged into bodies by id before tools/derive_stats.py runs; these win over derived values. Population totals about 1.2 million awake. gmHooks are GM-only.

profile.printAccess: licensed print shops; master licenses kept in the Bench archive
gmHooks: A thaw list is about to leak again, and someone wants a crew to make sure it reaches the Stacks before Command can bury it.
PATIENCE has frozen a contract's escrow and will not say why; both parties want it released by any means.
Saltmarsh's two hundred frames are quartered near Command. Find out whose orders they are waiting for.
Director Sato wants an inventory of the yards' spare capital-grade parts before either Navy camp asks for it.
THRESHOLD will trade what it knows about the gate for ten minutes alone with the drone.
The picket's levy books do not match the Assay House's. Someone at Cinder is skimming lattice.
A Compact district offers a truce if someone neutral will carry its terms to Ferrante past the League's patrols.
A Survey Office shaft has reached a climate structure and found it warmer than it should be.
Riverlands grain convoys keep disappearing on one stretch of river road, and not all of them to the Compact.
The Lantern Company families on the Marrow will pay to get their people out of the Corvel landing, alive and quietly.
A Synod elder wants proof that Corvel is arming the besieged force through a Long Families runner.
The southern ring has started to shed snow at its edge for the first time on record.

profile.claims: Assembly title; the Assay House, Sable brokers and Smith-Shimano all want the new lattice seams
gmHooks: The Assembly needs a ship's master willing to run refugees past Halloran's Heirs to anywhere that will take them.
A Gardener cell is planning to wreck the first lattice dig on Orison, and the Assembly would rather it never came to that.
One of the failing structures has started working again, erratically, and the surges on that coast have stopped.
The Assembly's survey team on Sanctum has stopped answering.
Three powers' agents on Envoys' Quay are all paying the same broker for the same information.
The Long Families want the Ninefold pilot who burned their copy-house, and they know which town she is drinking in.
The Verdance Colonial Company needs frame pilots for the third landing and is not mentioning the first two.
Something under the settled platform is moving, slowly, against the still water.
Corvel has filed on Halcyon and wants the Synod's survey party gone before its claim is tested.
The second landing's records were never recovered. The colonial company would like them back before the third attempt.
The station's analysts have triangulated the signal to the Well, and the Survey Office has told them to say nothing.
The nine worlds have fallen into an alignment the station has never recorded, and the structure is warming.
A Gallowglass boarding team has been seen buying passage under false names on a Free Lines convoy.
LONGSHORE asks a crew to carry a sealed message to the Bench, and not through any Free Lines ship.
A Lumen design lab has hired a crew to recover a prototype from a Ringwreckers' fence at Tarn, no questions asked.
Navy inspectors want someone inside the design labs to confirm what they suspect about unregistered NHPs.
A harbormaster wants the Tallymen reminded who owns Sable, without starting a war.
Someone is selling Navy picket schedules on Brokers' Row.
A Guild crew went looking for one of the unidentified anchorages and came back without its pilot.
Rimelight wants an escort for the six-day run to Tarn; the last ore shipment never arrived.
Rimelight's lost station still answers hails with a recorded duty roster.

profile.claims: held outside the Allotment: the Purview does not recognize it on Gloam
gmHooks: A Coldwell camp is ready to surrender if someone can guarantee its people are not deported to the Marrow.
A Free Lines lander bound for the night side is carrying more than frames this time.
Castaigne's envoy to the Marrow needs an escort no Navy officer will be told about.

stats.tempNote: day side a wind-scoured desert; night side cold enough to stop an unheated reactor; people live in the twilight band

gmHooks: Mercer-Ibarra has raised the Gap rates for Purview convoys only, and wants it known that it was nothing personal.
A Seventh frigate is due at the quiet dock, and a Navy agent on the Rest knows the date.
Brimstone's native life is spreading onto the hull of anything that lands there.
The open season is starting late, and the Commune's elders think the machinery is failing like Orison's.
The Purview has offered Bellows protection from the Seventh; the Seventh has heard about the offer.
ORDINAL has sent an unsigned message to Aranda-Voss proposing terms.
Both halves of the Syndicate want ARBITRAGE's core, and one of them has hired a crew to take it.
A free company on the Seam has been paid by both sides for the same stretch of glass.
Custodians have surfaced at a deep site for the first time, above four hundred meters.

stats.tempNote: hot and dry under a white sun; the glass reflects heat into the faces of anyone crossing it

gmHooks: The Ferrous board is split on a Purview offer, and the deciding vote is stuck in the Boneyard.
A salvage team brought back a component that is still warm a week later.
The Basin Office and Smith-Shimano are both hiring for the same unsurveyed section of the yards.
A cradle in the rings has started drawing power.
The Bench needs its inspection team landed past Kerr-Varga's militia, and the ruling depends on what they find.
A stone ring has moved overnight onto Kerr-Varga's newest mine head.
A Corvel crew has landed on Ashlar despite the quarantine and lost three days instead of nineteen hours.
This year's charts from WAYMARK include a lane nobody has seen, ending at the Watchfire.
